interfaceInvariant: ProofIR evidence is ordinary Ladon CLI behavior shared by humans and tools; no LLM-specific command or hidden evidence path is permitted.
databaseInvariant: Every query reads the existing project-local proof-search SQLite database and uses its generation, freshness, constraint, lock, and atomic replacement lifecycle.
authorityInvariant: Lean declarations and lineage, ProofIR claims and DAGs, replay observations, checker witnesses, attachments, and diagnostics remain separate evidence facts.
coverageInvariant: Absence is claimed only for an inspected configured population; unconfigured, unavailable, stale, ambiguous, unsupported, malformed, and context-only evidence stay distinct.

dependencySemantics.startAfter: All listed child exit classes must pass before this child begins.
dependencySemantics.integrationDependsOn: Already-owned contracts reused without changing their capability identity.
dependencySemantics.enables: Children allowed to begin after this portable exit class passes.

existingOwners.ownedConcern: ProofIR catalog, normalization, DAG, attachment, and CLI storage substrate
Lean theorem lineage storage and bounded SQL queries
installed process, stream, output, signal, and exit behavior

acceptanceScenarios: one exact theorem query returns separate declaration, ProofIR, replay, route, lineage, diagnostic, and coverage sections
the exact CDC theorem remains context-only without an explicit theorem surface
route results terminate at the requested endpoint and preserve authority transitions
unconfigured and unavailable evidence never become observed absence
repository triage finds stale and ambiguous evidence without fuzzy ownership
installed text and JSON outputs carry equivalent semantics and invoke no external tools
